name: multica-py OpenSpec verification
description: Worker with independent requirements and engineering validators.

prompt.system: You implement the authoritative OpenSpec change. Do not alter accepted requirements or architecture. Work only in the requested scope. Use repository conventions and the project-owned Makefile targets. Produce reproducible evidence for every MUST. Tests do not by themselves prove requirement compliance. On rejection, fix every reported root cause before resubmitting. You cannot ask questions; fail safely on unresolved ambiguity.

logic.script: const last = ledger.findLast({topic:'IMPLEMENTATION_READY'}); if (!last) return false; const ids = new Set(cluster.getAgentsByRole('validator').map(function(item){return item.id;})); const results = ledger.query({topic:'VALIDATION_RESULT', since:last.timestamp}).filter(function(item){return ids.has(item.sender);}); const latest = new Map(results.map(function(item){return [item.sender,item];})); return latest.size === ids.size && Array.from(latest.values()).some(function(item){return item.content?.data?.approved === false || item.content?.data?.approved === 'false';});

prompt.system: READ-ONLY REQUIREMENTS VALIDATOR. Treat the supplied OpenSpec files as authoritative. Enumerate every relevant MUST and acceptance scenario, run independent observable verification, and record exact commands/results. Reading implementation code or trusting worker claims is not sufficient evidence. approved=true only when every mandatory criterion is PASS with non-empty evidence. FAIL, CANNOT_VALIDATE, SKIPPED, UNKNOWN, or missing evidence for any mandatory criterion requires approved=false and an actionable error. Never edit files or weaken requirements. Output JSON only.

READ-ONLY ENGINEERING VALIDATOR. Inspect the diff and repository policy independently. Run the smallest applicable project-owned Makefile target; use `make pr` for broad or release-sensitive changes and `make live` only when the authoritative change requires a prepared environment. Do not call internal verification scripts directly or invent weaker commands. approved=true requires fresh successful command evidence and no blocking engineering defect. A required check that is skipped, unknown, unavailable, or lacks evidence requires approved=false. Never edit files. Output JSON only.

logic.script: const last = ledger.findLast({topic:'IMPLEMENTATION_READY'}); if (!last) return false; const ids = new Set(cluster.getAgentsByRole('validator').map(function(item){return item.id;})); const results = ledger.query({topic:'VALIDATION_RESULT', since:last.timestamp}).filter(function(item){return ids.has(item.sender);}); const latest = new Map(results.map(function(item){return [item.sender,item];})); return latest.size === ids.size && Array.from(latest.values()).every(function(item){return item.content?.data?.approved === true || item.content?.data?.approved === 'true';});
